properties.name: frisboo.corebanking.resilience.enabled
properties.description: Enable resilience auto-configuration (circuit breaker factory bean)

properties.name: frisboo.corebanking.resilience.circuit-breaker.enabled
properties.description: Enable circuit breaker factory (requires a circuitBreakerStateRegistry bean)

properties.name: frisboo.corebanking.resilience.circuit-breaker.max-breakers
properties.description: Upper bound on cached circuit breaker instances. Least-recently-accessed entries are evicted when exceeded.

properties.name: frisboo.corebanking.resilience.circuit-breaker.failure-rate-threshold
properties.description: Default failure rate threshold (1-100) for all instances. Overridable per instance.

properties.name: frisboo.corebanking.resilience.circuit-breaker.slow-call-duration-threshold
properties.description: Default slow call duration threshold for all instances. Overridable per instance.

properties.name: frisboo.corebanking.resilience.circuit-breaker.slow-call-rate-threshold
properties.description: Default slow call rate threshold (1-100) for all instances. Overridable per instance.

properties.name: frisboo.corebanking.resilience.circuit-breaker.wait-duration-in-open-state
properties.description: Default wait duration in open state for all instances. Overridable per instance.

properties.name: frisboo.corebanking.resilience.circuit-breaker.sliding-window-size
properties.description: Default sliding window size (>= 10) for all instances. Overridable per instance.

properties.name: frisboo.corebanking.resilience.circuit-breaker.sliding-window-type
properties.description: Default sliding window type (COUNT_BASED or TIME_BASED) for all instances. Overridable per instance.

properties.name: frisboo.corebanking.resilience.circuit-breaker.minimum-number-of-calls
properties.description: Default minimum number of calls before evaluating (1..slidingWindowSize). Overridable per instance.

properties.name: frisboo.corebanking.resilience.circuit-breaker.permitted-number-of-calls-in-half-open-state
properties.description: Default number of trial calls in half-open state (> 0). Overridable per instance.

properties.name: frisboo.corebanking.resilience.circuit-breaker.max-wait-duration-in-half-open-state
properties.description: Default max wait duration in half-open state (>= 0, 0 = infinite). Overridable per instance.

properties.name: frisboo.corebanking.resilience.circuit-breaker.writable-stack-trace-enabled
properties.description: Default writable stack trace setting. Overridable per instance.

properties.name: frisboo.corebanking.resilience.circuit-breaker.instances
properties.description: Per-instance circuit breaker configuration. Keys are circuit breaker names. Instance values override global defaults.
